messages:
Maya: quick idea - what if we let clients hint a latency preference header (very small set: `fastpath` | `balanced` | `economy`) so ingress can route to low-latency tinybatch pools vs cost-optimized pools? :thinking:
Kevin: +1 on the concept. question: do we trust client hints or treat them as soft preferences with guardrails? we need to avoid tenants gaming fastpath.
Oliver: prefer soft preference. we already have per-tenant SLAs/credits. combine header with per-tenant fastpath quota and sampling.
Liz: thoughts on telemetry? we should tag every request with `routing.hint`, `routing.decision`, `est.units`, `latency_budget_ms` so we can retroactively tune.
Maya: sketch of header API:
```
POST /v1/embeddings
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer ...
  X-Embed-Latency-Pref: fastpath   # fastpath | balanced | economy
  X-Embed-Latency-Budget-ms: 80   # optional numeric hint
Body: { "inputs": [...] }
```
Kevin: nice. need server-side fallback rules: e.g. if tenant exhausted fastpath quota -> route to balanced and emit `routing.decision=demoted_by_quota`.
Oliver: also enforce shape checks before routing. huge-dim arrays shouldn't go to fastpath even if pref set.
Liz: agree; add preflight that estimates units and sets `est.units`. Console can surface a heatmap: rows by `shape_class` (tiny / normal / huge) and cols by `routing.decision`.
Maya: rollout plan proposal:
- add header parsing + soft routing in ingress (no metrics emitted yet)
- small canary (5%) with `routing.decision` telemetry enabled
- validate signal and calibrate `est.units` model vs real cost
- enable console dashboard + quota UI for fastpath
- open SDK patch to expose header in client libs
Kevin: telemetry events we need ASAP:
- `request.recv` { tenant, routing.hint }
- `preflight.estimate` { est_units, shape_class }
- `routing.choose` { decision, reason }
- `serve.path` { path_name, batch_size, latency_ms }
- `quota.bump` { tenant, fastpath_remaining }
Oliver: can we piggyback on existing preflight machinery? that returns dims/bytes already. just add a tiny classifier `shape_class` in preflight.
Liz: console query example for the heatmap (pseudo SQL):
```
SELECT shape_class, routing.decision, count(*) as requests,
  avg(serve.latency_ms) as p50_latency, sum(est.units) as units
FROM telemetry
WHERE timeframe = last_24h
GROUP BY shape_class, routing.decision
```
Maya: UX notes: show a per-tenant fastpath remaining meter and provide an opt-in dev toggle. default to off for orgs that haven't configured credits.
Kevin: security: header can't bypass auth; validate that header is untrusted input for any quota checks (i.e. we always use server-side counters).
Oliver: perf: tinybatch path needs a stricter max payload size; if preflight est_units > threshold -> reply 413 with helpful hint and `shape_hint` sample.
Liz: suggestion - include in 413 body a JSON hint: `{ "suggested_split": 4, "shape_class": "huge" }` so SDK can auto-split.
Maya: canary note: infra-bot will create canary fleet and annotate with `canary=latency-pref-v1`.
infra-bot: created canary deployment `latency-pref-ingress-v1` -> 5% traffic now. :rocket:
Kevin: we'll need an experiment to compare cost delta fastpath vs balanced per-est.unit cohort. add `experiment.id` tag.
Maya: action items: @Kevin add ingress impl PR; @Oliver patch preflight classifier; @Liz console heatmap panel; i'll draft SDK docs + sample 413 body; infra-bot will run canary.
deploy-bot: canary rollout progressing: 5% -> 10% in 30m if no errors.
Oliver: one more: update rate-limiter to account for `latency_pref` weight (fastpath consumes a small extra credit). otherwise tenants will spam.
Kevin: noted. i'll include fastpath_cost_multiplier in quota service.
Maya: thanks all. will sync tomorrow 11am to review telemetry spike thresholds. :calendar:
